title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省圣巴巴拉市镇的图布兰-索尔布德村划归同省萨拉加市镇的法案
title.en: An Act to Transfer the Barrio of Tuburan-Solbud from the Municipality of Santa Barbara to the Municipality of Zarraga, Both of the Province of Iloilo
title.orig: An Act to Transfer the Barrio of Tuburan-Solbud from the Municipality of Santa Barbara to the Municipality of Zarraga, Both of the Province of Iloilo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_221_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrio of Tuburan-Solbud, presently under the jurisdiction of the municipality of Santa Barbara, is hereby transferred to the municipality of Zarraga, Province of Iloilo.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 5, 1948.
